MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The USB WiFi adapter fits my history of buying practical networking accessories, although I would only choose it if I needed to fix a connection problem.",
    "The display adapter connects loosely with my past DVI cable purchase because both help connect equipment, but that does not establish a need for Micro HDMI."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "A replacement desktop, radio scanner, and driveway alarm do not address any need expressed by my accessory purchases.",
    "The Apple charging cable and Samsung tablet case require specific devices that my history does not establish I own.",
    "Buying a headset does not mean I need a dedicated sound card or an audio noise isolator; those solve different problems."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in computer accessories seems to have been stretched into interest in almost any electronic equipment.",
    "A past purchase seems to be treated as a reason to buy related equipment again, even when I have no new problem to solve."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My purchases are years or months apart and serve particular purposes; I rarely browse for additional equipment without a concrete need.",
    "The exact connector and device compatibility matter more to me than a broad resemblance to something I previously bought.",
    "My latest purchase concerned wired USB networking, which gives more reason to consider connectivity needs than unrelated audio or security equipment."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognize my interest in connectivity accessories but infer too many unrelated needs and unconfirmed devices."
}
